title: Relative Mayer Vietoris for qcqs etale compact support
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. All derived categories below are the bounded-below derived categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For a separated finite-type morphism $h:T\to B$ of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and a compactification $c=(j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T,p:\overline T\to B)$, with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p$ proper, set $Rh_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification] [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type between quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes and let $U,V\subset X$ be quasi-compact opens with $X=U\cup V$. Put $a=f|_U$, $b=f|_V$, $d=f|_{U\cap V}$. For $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and any chosen compactifications for $a,b,d,f$, there is a distinguished triangle $Rd_!(K|_{U\cap V})\to Ra_!(K|_U)\oplus Rb_!(K|_V)\to Rf_!K\to Rd_!(K|_{U\cap V})[1]$, where each shriek denotes its chosen candidate.
